title: Wizard Tile-Based Redesign — Visual Assessment Type Selection and Short Questions
goal: Replace the current open-ended conversational intake with a tile-based visual selector followed by 3-4 short targeted questions — making the mission setup fast, clear, and visually intuitive for both novice operators and experienced pentesters.
scope: Replace the current conversational wizard with a 3-step flow: STEP 1 — ASSESSMENT TYPE TILES: A grid of 8 visual tiles, each with an icon, title, and one-line description. Tiles: (1) External Web — globe icon, 'Websites, web apps, APIs reachable from the internet'; (2) Internal LAN — network icon, 'Internal network, subnets, on-premise servers'; (3) Active Directory — shield icon, 'Domain controllers, AD users, attack paths'; (4) Full Internal — fire icon, 'Complete internal assessment: LAN + AD + credential attacks + exploitation'; (5) Cloud (AWS/Azure) — cloud icon, 'Cloud infrastructure, IAM, exposed resources'; (6) API Security — brackets icon, 'REST, GraphQL, gRPC endpoints'; (7) LLM / AI App — robot icon, 'AI applications, prompt injection, LLM security'; (8) Custom — sliders icon, 'Build your own combination'. Each tile is a large card (~180×160px) with icon (48px), bold title, short description, and a subtle 'Recommended' badge on the most-used types. Selected tile gets cyan border and checkmark. STEP 2 — 3 SHORT QUESTIONS shown one at a time with large text and clear input: Q1: 'What is the target?' — text input with placeholder and validation; Q2: 'How deep should we go?' — 3 tiles: Passive only / Active scan / Full including exploitation; Q3: 'Any targets to exclude?' — optional, shows only if target has multiple hosts. No more than 3 questions total for most paths. STEP 3 — MISSION PREVIEW DIAGRAM (covered in backlog-78). This backlog covers steps 1 and 2 only. The existing advanced drawer remains accessible throughout for operators who need exact parameter control. All existing deterministic run configuration logic is preserved under the new UI — the tiles map to existing run profiles.
generation_reason: The current conversational wizard is slow, unclear, and requires too many steps. Tile-based selection with short questions is the standard pattern in modern security tools (Aikido, NodeZero) and dramatically reduces time-to-first-run. Most operators know immediately what they want to test — the wizard should confirm scope in 60 seconds, not 5 minutes.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Steps 1 and 2 only — tile selection and short questions. The visual mission preview diagram is covered in backlog-78. All existing run profile and deterministic configuration logic is preserved. Advanced drawer remains accessible. No backend changes.

success_criteria: Step 1 shows 8 visual assessment type tiles with icons, titles, and descriptions.
Selected tile gets cyan border and checkmark indicator.
Step 2 shows 3 or fewer short questions one at a time with large clear text.
Depth selection is a 3-tile choice: Passive / Active / Full.
All existing run profiles map correctly from tile selections.
Wizard completes target + profile configuration in under 5 clicks for common paths.
Full Playwright suite remains green after wizard expectation updates.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Short question flow completes in 3 questions for common paths.

before_promotion: Assessment Mode automated chain (backlog-76) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with wizard tile redesign implementation.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with tile-based wizard as active intake.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
